title: The next horizontal tail is the kernel of the restricted signed projection
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] in which every natural-indexed bicomplex has a total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism of bicomplexes of shape $\mathrm{up}(\mathbb N)$ in both directions, and put $M=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(\operatorname{Tot}(f)))$, with extension along $\mathbb N\hookrightarrow\mathbb Z$. Let $F$ be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $M$ with $F.\mathrm{complexStep}(r,m)=\mathrm{coneHorizontalStep}(f,r,m)$ for all $r,m\in\mathbb Z$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients; lem-sp-cone-horizontal-step-stable]. For $p\in\mathbb N$, $n\in\mathbb Z$, put $T=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(f.f(p)))[-p]$ and let $g:(F^pM)^n\to T^n$ be the filtration inclusion followed by the signed column projection [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection]. Let $i:(F^{p+1}M)^n\to(F^pM)^n$ be the degreewise inclusion given by filtration antitonicity. Then $\operatorname{im}(i)=\ker(g)$ as subobjects of $(F^pM)^n$.

source.place: Displayed first-filtration formula before Lemma 12.25.1 (label lemma-double-complex), and the source/target cone refinement of lem-sp-cone-horizontal-quotient-iso-exists, proof step 1.

proof.text: Identify the total degree m with the finite diagonal biproduct of K^{h,m-h} for 0<=h<=m using the totalComplex coproduct inclusions and totalDesc. For negative m the extended total object is zero. The cone biproduct is the sum of the source diagonal at n+1 and the target diagonal at n. Each summand inclusion is monic and these inclusions give biproduct coordinates. The finite supremum of their images for h>=p is therefore the image of the inclusion of the sub-biproduct on exactly those coordinates; this is coneHorizontalStep f p n.

In the tail coordinates the signed projection g keeps only the two coordinates at index p. Its source coefficient is (-1)^p and its target coefficient is 1, both invertible. The kernel of this projection is the sub-biproduct with both index-p coordinates deleted, by the finite-biproduct kernel calculation. All the remaining indices are >=p+1, so its ambient image is precisely coneHorizontalStep f (p+1) n. If n<p-1 the p-tail and target are zero; if n=p-1 there is only a source coordinate, whose projection is invertible. These cases give the same kernel description.

Evaluation sends the monic subcomplex arrows and the inclusion of F.step (p+1) into F.step p to monomorphisms, and their composite is the next-step arrow. The equality hF identifies their ambient image with the next coordinate tail. Pulling back that ambient subobject along the monic arrow of F.step p identifies image(i) inside (F.step p).X n with the kernel calculated above. This proves equality of subobjects rather than only an abstract isomorphism of their underlying objects.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_projection_kernel
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n = coneHorizontalStep f p n)
    (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    imageSubobject ((Subobject.ofLE (F.step ((p : ℤ) + 1))
      (F.step (p : ℤ)) (F.antitone_step (by omega))).f n) =
      kernelSubobject ((F.step (p : ℤ)).arrow.f n ≫ coneHorizontalProjection f p n)
